title: Sweep the porch

steps.text: Move shoes and toys to one side.
steps.tip: Sweep is easier with a clear path.
Short strokes toward the pile. Do not fling dust at the door.

steps.text: Scoop with the dustpan into the outdoor trash.
steps.tip: Hold the dustpan flat on the ground.

steps.text: Put shoes back neatly and return the broom.
steps.tip: Line shoes in a row by the door.

done_when: Dirt is in the trash, not in the grass by the door
parent_notes: Daylight only. No ladders, no wet leaves ice, no power blower in v1.
